fields.description: The selling price list used by the POS Profile. Menu dish prices are read from it.
fields.label: Selling Price List

fields.description: The warehouse the POS sells from. Daily prep is posted here.
fields.label: Kitchen Warehouse

fields.description: Lets the POS sell a dish even when its prepared ingredients were not posted yet. Raw materials stay blocked from going negative.
fields.label: Allow Negative Stock for Prepared Ingredients
Staff Meals Account
fields.description: The expense account a staff meal is posted to, at the stock's cost (no sale).
A dish whose recipe cost is at or below this percentage of its selling price is green. Also the target of the restaurant as a whole in Resto Analytics and the Food Cost report.
fields.label: Target Food Cost %

fields.description: Colors of a dish's food cost % (recipe cost / selling price) in the recipe list, the recipe and item forms and Recipe Status: green up to the target, then yellow, then orange, then red; 100% or more is a full red bar marked with ⚠. Saving a dish above the target shows a warning; the save is not stopped.
fields.label: Food Cost

fields.description: Yellow up to the target plus this many points.
fields.label: Yellow: Points Above Target

fields.description: Orange up to the target plus this many points; red above that.
fields.label: Orange: Points Above Target
POS Profile
fields.description: Bills from the floor screen are made with this POS Profile: payment methods, taxes, warehouse and default customer.

fields.label: Require an Open Shift
fields.description: No order is taken, sent or billed without an open shift: a cashier or manager opens their own (Open Shift on the floor screen); a waiter works while any cashier's shift is open. The shift closing counts every bill.

fields.label: Blind Shift Count
fields.description: When closing a shift the cashier counts the drawer without seeing the expected amounts; they are shown after the shift is closed.

fields.label: Cash Over/Short Account
fields.description: When a shift closes with a cash difference, a Journal Entry moves it between the cash account and this account, so the cash account holds what was counted (a card or wallet difference stays on the shift only). Empty: no entry.

fields.label: Drawer Expenses Cap per Shift
fields.description: The most a cashier may pay out of the drawer in one shift. 0: no cap.

fields.label: Drawer Expense Needs a Receipt
fields.description: The cashier attaches a photo of the receipt to every drawer expense.

fields.label: Drawer Expense Accounts
fields.description: The expense accounts a cashier may pay from the drawer. Empty: any ordinary expense account.

fields.label: Cash Purchase Needs a Manager Above
fields.description: A cash purchase from the drawer above this amount needs a manager's PIN. 0: never.

fields.label: Cash Supplier
fields.description: The supplier of a cash purchase from the drawer when the cashier names none. Empty: a supplier called Cash Supplier is made on the first one.

fields.label: Staff Advances Account
fields.description: A receivable (asset) account: an advance paid to a worker from the drawer is owed by them, by name, until it is taken off their salary or paid back.

fields.label: Staff Advance Needs a Manager Above
fields.description: A staff advance from the drawer above this amount needs a manager's PIN. 0: never.

fields.label: A Cashier's Own Advance Needs a Manager
fields.description: A cashier paying an advance to themself (the worker whose User is theirs) needs a manager's PIN, whatever the amount.

fields.label: Main Safe Account
fields.description: The cash account of the main safe (type Cash, not the drawer's own): a cash drop from the drawer goes into it, and change for the drawer comes out of it. Both need a manager's PIN.

fields.label: When a Cash Account Would Go Below Zero
fields.description: A cash box holds no less than nothing: below zero means cash that came in was not recorded, or an expense was posted twice. Warn Only asks before submitting; Block the Posting refuses it.

fields.label: Drawer Cash In Accounts
fields.description: The accounts money put into the drawer for another reason may come from (a manager's PIN and a note each time). Empty: no other reason is offered.

fields.label: Salaries Account
fields.description: The expense account the month's salary entry posts the workers' salaries to.

fields.label: Let Staff Change the Sides Served
fields.description: On the floor screen the waiter or cashier can change a dish's sides (Served With) for one dish or for several dishes together: swap a side for another option of its side group, or change its portions. What is served is deducted from stock and costed on the dish. Off: every dish is served with its recipe's sides.

fields.label: Charge Portions Above the Recipe's Sides
fields.description: Portions of a side above what the dish's recipe serves become their own line on the customer's invoice, at the side option's extra price; their stock and cost belong to that line. A swap for another option of the same count is not an extra. Off: extra portions are free and costed on the dish.

fields.label: Free Extras Without Approval Up To
fields.description: Per order, at the extra price: a cashier may give extra portions free up to this value; above it, or when it is 0, a manager's PIN is needed. Stock is still issued.

fields.label: Show the Sides on Every Dish in the Kitchen
fields.description: The kitchen screen and ticket show every dish's sides, also when they are the recipe's own (for new cooks). Off: only sides that differ from the recipe. The bill and the receipt are not changed.

fields.label: Screen Refresh (Seconds)
fields.description: Floor and kitchen screens also reload on this interval, in case live updates are off.

fields.label: Enable Screen Lock
fields.description: Floor users can lock their screen and open it with their own PIN. Off: no Lock Screen, no locking by itself, and only managers set a PIN (for approvals).

fields.label: Lock the Floor Screen After (Minutes)
fields.description: A floor screen left untouched this long locks itself; its user opens it with their own PIN (set from the floor's user menu). 0: it locks only from the user menu.

fields.label: Show Reservation Before (Minutes)
fields.description: A table shows as reserved this many minutes before the reservation time.
Sales before this hour count for the day before, for a restaurant open past midnight (for example 4: a bill at 01:30 on Friday counts for Thursday). 0: the calendar day. Used by the demand reports.
fields.label: Business Day Starts At (Hour)
Charge VAT on Service
fields.description: Taxes of the POS Profile template are charged on the items plus the service charge.

fields.label: Delivery Fee Item
fields.description: A non-stock service item. The delivery fee is billed as this item.

fields.label: Packaging and Consumables
fields.description: Taken from stock on the bill at no price, into the bill's cost of goods sold apart from the food cost; a return never puts them back. Each dish takes the Packaging rows of its recipe ticked for the order's type; each order takes the rows below ticked for its type, once per order or once per guest.

fields.label: Cashier Discount Limit %
fields.description: Bigger discounts need the Resto Manager role.

fields.label: Printing
fields.description: How the bill (before payment) and the receipt (after payment) are printed.

fields.label: Cashier Printing Method
fields.options:
Server Printer
Browser Automatic
Browser Button
No Printing
fields.description: Server Printer: bills and receipts print on the cashier network printer through the server. Browser Automatic: the cashier computer prints them on its own printer (Chrome started with kiosk printing prints with no window): the bill when it is requested, the receipt as soon as it is paid. Browser Button: the bill prints when it is requested, the receipt with the Print Receipt button. No Printing: nothing prints by itself; the Print Receipt button still prints. Every way prints all the copies below, each with its label.

fields.label: Print the Bill on the Cashier Printer
Bill Copies
fields.description: One row per copy, each printed with its label. No rows: one copy.

fields.label: Receipt Copies
fields.description: One row per copy, each printed with its label. No rows: one copy.

fields.label: Receipt Print Format
fields.description: The receipt Resto prints, with all its copies. Resto Receipt shows each copy label, the side dishes on the copies that show them, the order number and the kitchen ticket numbers. Empty: the print format of the POS Profile.

fields.label: Backups
fields.description: The nightly backup and its off-site copy. The upload script marks each copy that left this machine (resto.resto.backup_watch.mark_offsite_ok, or the time in private/backups/.offsite_ok).

fields.label: Watch the Daily Backup
fields.description: Managers get a notification and a red bar when the newest backup or its off-site copy is older than the limit.
